profile.summary: jonathanong is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Node.js and Express.js backend development. Their contributions focus heavily on middleware architecture, HTTP protocol handling, and API endpoint design within Express.js. The developer demonstrates strong skills in modularizing backend components, managing dependencies, and ensuring backward compatibility. While their contributions are purely backend-focused with no evidence of frontend frameworks or TypeScript usage, they show deep technical proficiency in Node.js ecosystems. Their work emphasizes clean code practices, dependency cleanup, and efficient middleware implementations, indicating a solid understanding of server-side JavaScript patterns.
